_description: R3-40, the 40 MHz rollback: sub-6 2420 MHz + X-band IF 4380 MHz, both at 106 RB, 4096 FFT, 30 kHz, unsteered
_comment: AP-79's 40 MHz rollback of R3 (houdini-dualband.json), for when the link at 50 MHz disappoints: sub-6 2400 to 2440 MHz at NCO 2420 and the X-band IF at NCO 4380, both at 106 RB = 1272 subcarriers = 38.16 MHz. Everything else, cabling included, as R3 (see its _comment).
_status: RAN once as R3-40 and decodes (DEMO_VERIFICATION 9.6; the seat 0.2 +- 0.7, 9.4); not run on the demo head. Use it only if the link at 50 MHz disappoints.
_rates_note: sample_rate stays 122.88e6: it is the RX rate AND the device tick, and every slot/frame count below is in those ticks. The TX stream runs at tx_sample_rate; every TX waveform is generated at 122.88 and x2 interpolated at the radio boundary (include/dsp/band_filters.h). DAC 5898.24 / interpolation 24, ADC 4915.2 / decimation 40.
_frequency_note: Common NCO is the sub-6 2420 MHz (this 40 MHz rollback); only the X-band channels override it (TX ch1 = B, RX ch2 = C). Zone, ADC calibration mode, inverse sinc and the +-24 MHz RX channel filter are DERIVED per channel from the NCO and the converter rates (PG269 rules), not configured: sub-6 -> zone 1, cal mode 1, filter on; X-IF -> zone 2, cal mode 2, filter off. frequency is the carrier the CFO ppm is quoted against (the sub-6 beacon link).
_gain_note: houdini_rx_gain_db / houdini_tx_gain_db: one value per direction, written to every channel the radio opens and read back at start, so attenuating the sub-6 RX attenuates the X-band RX too. RX is minus the step attenuator's attenuation (0 = none); TX 0 dB = maximum VOP, where the software lane measured linearity (W2). The device's make() resets RX DSA to 0 dB and TX VOP to 20 mA before they are written. The ue_*_gain_* fields below are Iris units and inert on Houdini.
_numerology_note: 5G-like, fixed CP (plan section 3.3): SCS 30 kHz = 122.88 MHz / 4096, CP 288 (NR normal), symbol 4384 ticks. 14 symbols = 61376 ticks + zero prefix 32 + postfix 32 = 61440 ticks = exactly 0.5 ms (NR's slot) = 160 x 384, so every slot starts on the 384-tick TDD grid. 1272 data subcarriers = 106 RB = 38.16 MHz (+-19.08, inside the +-24 MHz filter passband) on both bands; R3 (houdini-dualband.json) carries 1596 (133 RB).
_schedule_note: B, G, P, U then guards: 20 slots x 0.5 ms = 10 ms (NR's radio frame). The UE sends its pilot in slot 2 and uplink data in slot 3 on BOTH its TX channels (sub-6 and X-IF; the BS separates them by channel, as in AP-78's shared pilot slot).
_beacon_note: nr_pss_bl: the band-limited beacon (AP-79): the 127-tone NR PSS at 240 kHz behind NR's 36-sample CP, then a guarded TRS pair on the central 96 tones (+-23 MHz); 1076 ticks. tx_full_scale 0.34 = -16 dBFS RMS at its 6.6 dB PAPR, the plan's DAC back-off. The argmax pick: the shipped first_path rule lands 2 samples early on this lobe (beacon_bandlimit_test).
_carried_note: tx_advance is re-measured at mode V (169, see _tx_advance_note). The detection thresholds are DERIVED for nr_pss_bl on a simulated link (tests/comms-func/detection_calibration_test.cc): corr_scale 5 (coherence bar 0.2; noise-only max 0.080 of 400 windows, a beacon 30 dB under bench level 0.90), snr_floor_db 25 (legacy's 30 shifted by the measured -5.2 dB for this beacon at 0.34 peak on the filtered lane, 16.6 dB margin). detector.min_bar 0.1 stops the resync retry relaxation (+1 on corr_scale per retry) from walking the bar into the noise (at corr_scale 5 it moves it 20% a retry). ue_pilot_horizon counts FRAMES.
_tx_advance_note: BENCH CALIBRATION, mode-V converter path: 169 = 247 (the one-rate path's value) + the mean pilot_grid_off of -78 samples (sd 3.8, no drift over 80 s) measured at R1 with --bs_rx_debug once the BS framer placed the pilot by its leading edge (DEMO_VERIFICATION 9.4). Mode V moves the pilot 78 samples EARLY against the one-rate path: the x24 DAC interpolation and x40 ADC decimation carry a different pipeline latency. With 169 the seat reads -2.2 +- 0.8 at R3a, -1.0 +- 0.9 at R3 and 0.2 +- 0.7 at R3-40 (9.4), -2/-3 cabled on fpga 1.33 and 0..+2 on 1.34 (9.69-9.71), inside the +-32 slot margin; it moves by a few samples between sessions, untraced (9.73). Re-derive after any cabling or converter change: run with --bs_rx_debug across a few restarts and shift tx_advance by the mean pilot_grid_off.
